prompt: A total function takes the inputs {1, 2, 3}, declares outputs in {a, b, c}, and sends every input to a. What is its image?

options.explanation: This is the declared codomain, including outputs that the function never reaches.
These are inputs in the domain, rather than outputs.
The image contains exactly the outputs reached by at least one input.
The function does produce an output: every input produces a.

workedExample: Evaluate the function at each of the three allowed inputs. All three outputs are a. A set lists distinct elements, so collecting those outputs gives the singleton set {a}.
